title: Collections Ruling: Shortfall Reason and the Form of the Late Charge (Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement)
content:
How the late charge on an employer-liable shortfall notice of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement is worked out follows the reason the shortfall stands under, as recorded on the notice:

| Shortfall reason on the notice | Late charge |
|---|---|
| deducted but not remitted, money deducted from workers' pay and kept | the tier's minimum late charge plus the percentage charge |
| payroll processing error | the percentage charge alone, with no minimum |
| deduction not taken | the percentage charge alone, with no minimum |
| any other reason, unreported included | the greater of the tier's minimum late charge and the percentage charge |

The percentage charge is the late charge rate applied to the notice's open amount and rounded half up to the cent.

## Illustration (hypothetical minimum of 50.00 and percentage charge of 31.20)

- Deducted but not remitted: 50.00 plus 31.20, a late charge of 81.20.
- Payroll processing error, or deduction not taken: 31.20.
- Unreported: the greater of 50.00 and 31.20, that is 50.00.
